description: This source file defines the PermissionMonitoringSupport enum, which provides static methods to control permission monitoring via PermissionMonitor singleton, including methods to enable/disable monitoring and stop monitoring.

classes.name: PermissionMonitoringSupport
classes.description: An enum providing static methods to manage permission monitoring.

methods.name: setMonitoring
methods.description: Enables or disables permission monitoring based on the shouldMonitor parameter, updating the monitoring state and registering/unregistering the PermissionMonitor accordingly.

methods.name: stopMonitoring
methods.description: Stops permission monitoring if it is currently active by unregistering the PermissionMonitor.
